images.caption:
Wet cobble stones and fog at closing time on Laclede's Landing.

By the way, if you are ever out late on the St. Louis riverfront, remember that the last train for the other side of the river leaves at 1:14 AM.  So, if you arrive on the platform at 1:16 AM, like I did, you are completely out of luck!
images.alt:
Wet cobble stones and fog at closing time on Laclede's Landing.

By the way, if you are ever out late on the St. Louis riverfront, remember that the last train for the other side of the river leaves at 1:14 AM.  So, if you arrive on the platform at 1:16 AM, like I did, you are completely out of luck!

images.caption:
The Switzer Building before the wrecking ball. The front section of this building collapsed in the summer storm of July 2006, and it sat this way until May of 2007 when it was torn down completely. 

Sadly, I didn't get any pics of the building before it collapsed.
